description: Simplify Output is off, so the item is the full Responses API payload rather than just the assistant messages.

output.description: All output items, NOT only assistant messages: reasoning summaries, tool calls, and built-in tool results are interleaved here. `output[0]` is therefore not reliably the reply — filter for `type === 'message'` first, then read `content[0].text`.

text.description: String for a plain reply; an already-parsed object when Output Format is JSON Object or JSON Schema
